scope: Read-only audit of what residual-chain, Amdahl, preservation break-even, plot, and final-classification analysis remains scientifically calculable after the valid attempt-D A100 micro-validation and the terminal pre-reclaim failure of integrated attempt B.

terminal_evidence_boundary.rule: Attempt-D micro measurements remain valid but cannot be relabeled as integrated serving-path measurements. Attempt B contributes only its pre-reclaim failure and cleanup/budget evidence.

defensible_measured_micro_quantities.apparent_throughput_warning: These are one-point endpoint ratios. They do not identify a fixed overhead plus byte-rate model and are not fitted beta coefficients.

source_export_stage.interpretation: Measured micro source state stage: native gather/repack, integrity, and D2H plus its bounded control work.

destination_restore_stage.interpretation: Measured micro destination state stage: preflight and consumption authentication, H2D, direct scatter/native write, and raw-bit validation plus bounded control work.

micro_residual_stage_observations.timing_non_additivity_rule: CUDA event time, synchronization wait, integrity owner wall, and endpoint wall are different views and may overlap. They must not be summed into a synthetic critical path. Timing-owner wall intervals are unioned once; uncovered endpoint duration is not classified as CPU, GPU, idle, or synchronization without further trace evidence.

micro_stage_sensitivity_envelope.scope_warning: This algebra accelerates an entire measured micro endpoint stage, including all of its software/control overhead. It is an optimistic diagnostic envelope, not an isolated residual fused-chain estimate, integrated serving Amdahl result, realistic accelerator projection, or hardware-economic result.
micro_stage_sensitivity_envelope.equation: For one stage X in the non-overlapping micro endpoint sum T=E+R, T'(k)=T-X+X/k and speedup=T/T'(k).
prohibited_interpretations: Do not call either baseline fraction an integrated reclamation, useful-capacity, SLO-restoration, or rollout-restore critical-path share.
Do not treat aggregate CUDA-event-time divided by endpoint wall as an Amdahl fraction because double buffering and host work can overlap CUDA execution.
Do not treat the whole-stage acceleration envelope as a realistic single GPU kernel or external-accelerator speedup.
Do not use these envelopes to satisfy the >=1.20x BranchFabric hardware-interest predicate.

required_integrated_amdahl_paths.reason: Attempt B failed before reclaim. No integrated v11 export/release/HBM-reclaim/useful-GPU1/restore interval exists, so neither a denominator nor non-overlapping residual stage intervals exist for these paths.

identified: The frozen point has 18,432 unique logical token-equivalents and q=57,344 logical state bytes per unique token-equivalent.
Independent kill/recompute work is analytically 133,120 tokens for the frozen topology.
The valid micro preserve endpoint sum is 7.051284484 seconds and measured physical amplification is 21.000762818351625x at this one point.
preservation_break_even.one_point_degeneracy: The identity 7.051284484 = delta_p + a*q*(P+B*A)/beta is one equation with at least delta_p and beta unknown. Infinite coefficient pairs fit it, and a was measured at only one topology. No prefix, branch-count, age, or suffix break-even curve can therefore be fitted.

conditional_not_a_fit.assumptions: Only if delta_k=0 and the micro endpoint sum is substituted for integrated preserve time at the frozen point
conditional_not_a_fit.direction: Under only those assumptions, preserve would be faster for theta below the equality value.
conditional_not_a_fit.use_restriction: Sensitivity check only. Do not report, plot, or classify this as measured break-even.

preservation_break_even.branch_age_private_suffix_alias: The supplied analytical model has one A variable, so branch age and private suffix length are the same degree of freedom. They cannot be independently fitted without a revised state/recompute model and additional measurements.
preservation_break_even.oracle_exclusion: The attempt-D independent continuation oracle is a correctness oracle over already prepared runtime state. Its elapsed time and token outputs are not a causal kill/re-prefill throughput sample and must not be used for theta, delta_k, recompute GPU-seconds, or cost.

SOFTWARE_WINS.reason: The measured amplification reduction is real, but neither remaining-state-pipeline share on an important integrated critical path nor ideal-free full-system speedup was measured.

GPU_SOFTWARE_WINS.reason: The micro trace identifies GPU work, but realistic GPU-only headroom and external-accelerator incremental end-to-end improvement were not measured on an integrated path.

BRANCHFABRIC_HARDWARE_INTEREST.reason: Required integrated critical-path share, realistic >=1.20x economically important end-to-end improvement, burst/concurrency/interference evidence, and plausible out-of-GPU placement advantage are absent. The explicit experiment rule also forbids hardware interest without measured integrated v11 timings.

PRESERVATION_NOT_ECONOMIC.reason: The kill/recompute arm was not run, so preservation cannot be shown inferior at the frozen workload or nearby regimes.

classification_constraints.required_terminal_reporting: Report the experiment as terminally scientifically invalid after the valid micro gate, with FINAL_CLASSIFICATION=NOT_DETERMINED_FROM_AVAILABLE_EVIDENCE. Forcing one enum member would violate the predicates and fabricate a conclusion.

strict_non_fabrication_rules: Keep valid attempt-D micro measurements separate from invalid attempt-B integrated evidence.
Do not reuse v10 integrated timings as v11 denominators or residual times.
Do not infer integrated HBM reclamation, useful GPU1, queue drain, SLO restoration, rollout restore, or GPU0 restore interference from micro timing.
Do not sum endpoint wall, CUDA events, integrity spans, synchronization waits, or timing-owner intervals when they overlap or describe different timing views.
Do not convert the correctness oracle into kill/recompute throughput, tokens, GPU-seconds, or setup overhead.
Do not fit fixed overhead and byte throughput from one preserve point.
Do not draw numeric prefix, branch-count, branch-age, or private-suffix break-even curves without measured kill coefficients and multipoint preserve scaling.
Do not treat pre-reclaim overload samples as integrated state-pipeline or restore-interference evidence.
Use null plus explicit NOT_REACHED or NOT_IDENTIFIABLE states; never zero-fill missing measurements.
Do not generate Experiment 005 or claim BranchFabric hardware interest.
review_pass: The terminal analysis is scientifically sound only if it reports the measured micro stage and byte results, optionally publishes the explicitly scoped micro-stage sensitivity envelope, leaves all integrated Amdahl paths and numeric break-even curves null, and declines all four final classifications as unestablished rather than inventing missing arms.
